WordPress Website Manager Job at Pianogoddess Academy




        
    

        
        Pianogoddess Academy is a female instrumental academy with vision of raising and training female instrumentalist across Nigeria. It is also a platform where everyone, both male and female can learn music in the simplest way ever. Our academy is dedicated to nurturing the next generation of musicians, empowering them to unleash their creativity and confidence. We believe that music has the power to transform lives. That’s why we’re dedicated to providing exceptional music education that inspires, motivates, and nurtures our students. From classical to contemporary, our expert instructors will guide you on your musical journey, helping you to discover your unique style. Join us and become a part of our dynamic community of musicians
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: WordPress Website Manager

Job Location: Bwari, Abuja

Responsibilities


	Manage and update WordPress websites.
	Upload and organize website content.
	Maintain website security and performance.
	Install and manage plugins and themes.
	Fix website issues and errors.
	Optimize website speed and SEO.
	Monitor website performance and traffic.


Requirements


	Proficiency in WordPress website management.
	Basic knowledge of SEO and website optimization.
	Experience with plugins, themes, and site customization.
	Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to manage and update content regularly.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV + portfolio to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note: For more information or clarifications, contact: 08136277338.
